items.description: Replaces `JournalDrawer`'s modal `<dialog>` with a non-modal dock that overlays the page from the bottom edge or, with `side="right"`, the right edge, renders its own toggle, can be resized by drag or arrow keys through a separator, and reports its size through `onSizeChange` so that an app can keep the size across reloads by passing it back as `defaultSize`. (#18)
items.migration: Replace `onClose` with `onOpenChange`, which receives the next open state and must set it, because the dock's own toggle now opens the dock as well as closing it; rename any `.readout-drawer*` selectors to `.readout-dock*`; and pad the page by the size that `onSizeChange` reports, because the dock and its toggle now cover the page's bottom edge or right edge instead of blocking the page.

items.description: Colours `CopyButton`'s copied and failed states with the new `--readout-success` and `--readout-danger` custom properties, which have light and dark values. (#18)
Add tour-react, a step-by-step product tour in a dialog (#20)
items.body: Adds the `@williamthorsen/tour-react` package, a React product tour that shows an ordered list of steps as slides in a modal dialog, and a `useFirstRunTour` hook that opens the tour once, on an app's first launch.

items.description: Sets `engines.node` back to `>=24` in every package and to `>=24.16.0` at the root, reversing the unreleased raise to `>=26`, and pins `@types/node` to 24.19.2 in the catalog to match. (#26)

items.body: Adds the `@williamthorsen/terminal-react` workspace at `0.0.0`, which declares `@xterm/xterm`, `@xterm/addon-fit`, and a `./styles.css` export but doesn't contain any source yet, and registers it in the README, `AGENTS.md`, the release-kit config, and the `scope:terminal-react` label. Moves the React dependencies that it shares with `readout-react` into the `pnpm-workspace.yaml` catalog at the versions that `readout-react` already pinned.

items.description: Adds `CopyButton`, which copies a text and reports the result in its label and to a screen reader, `JsonView`, which shows JSON in a scrollable region that a keyboard user can focus, and `EmbeddedJson`, which embeds JSON in a `<script type="application/json">` element for a driven browser to read. (#11)

Adds `ReadoutView`, which shows a readout on a Details tab and its JSON on a Data tab and always embeds that JSON without the sensitive fields, and `ReadoutPanel`, the Data tab's content on its own, which includes the sensitive fields only after the person turns on "Include sensitive fields". (#11)

Adds `useJournal`, a hook that holds a state under a reducer and journals each transition, and `JournalDrawer`, a modal dialog that lists the journal's entries newest first and shows the journal as JSON with Copy JSON. (#11)

Adds `@williamthorsen/readout-react/styles.css`, the stylesheet imported by a consumer to style every component, which declares each colour as a `--readout-` custom property with a dark set so that an app can override the properties to theme the components. (#11)
